Case 02 · Programmatic architecture

Scaling a UK vehicle-scrapping service with programmatic pages that stay useful

A UK vehicle-scrapping service relied on a large programmatic page architecture, where templates generate pages at scale.

Monthly average = 16 months total ÷ 16. Real months vary; this is arithmetic, not a trend line.

The situation

A UK vehicle-scrapping service relied on a large programmatic page architecture, where templates generate pages at scale.

At that scale the template itself becomes part of the ranking strategy: weak templates multiply into thousands of thin pages.

What I did

  1. 01

    Audit before action

    Opened with an initial audit, a master analysis, and a site-drop technical analysis, then a prioritized action plan.

  2. 02

    Manufacturer pages at scale

    Built manufacturer landing pages at scale from content outlines and finalized their FAQs.

  3. 03

    Market expansion research

    Researched expansion into scrap yards, car breakers, and the Ireland market.

  4. 04

    Technical hardening

    Optimized robots.txt, Core Web Vitals, schema, and staging-domain linking.

  5. 05

    Link profile cleanup

    Cleaned toxic backlinks and ran outreach.

Disciplines involved
